name: Agents Anywhere — Workspace Chat Beta
description: Opt-in workspace chat through the current Agents Anywhere Connector protocol: discover, create, send, sync replies, interrupt and reconnect.

en.name: Agents Anywhere — Workspace Chat Beta
en.description: Share the selected workspace's Pi sessions with Agents Anywhere. Discover sessions, create chats, send messages, sync text replies and interrupt turns.
en.safetyNotes: High risk: separate sharing consent uploads workspace paths, session titles, user/assistant text, model identifiers and status to the declared server and permits remote prompts and interruption. Prompts may invoke local agent tools under each session's existing permissions; new sessions require native confirmation for Ask mode. Credentials stay in memory; only scoped IDs, hashes and operation receipts persist. No pasted command execution or remote approval bypass. Disconnect stops sharing, not an already accepted agent turn. Beta: real Cloud acceptance and redirect security review remain pending.

zh-CN.name: Agents Anywhere — 工作区聊天 Beta
zh-CN.description: 经单独确认后共享当前工作区的 Pi 会话，支持发现会话、新建聊天、发送消息、同步文字回复和中断任务。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 高风险：单独确认共享后，将工作区路径、会话标题、用户及助手文字、模型标识和状态上传至声明的服务器，并允许远程发消息及中断。消息可能按会话现有权限调用本地 Agent 工具；新建会话须通过宿主确认启用 Ask 模式。凭据仅驻留内存，仅持久化分域 ID、摘要和操作回执。不执行粘贴命令，不绕过审批。断开停止共享，但不终止已接收的任务。Beta 尚待真实 Cloud 验收与重定向安全核验。
